notes: Datasets page recovery: when a page module is not registered (stale Android cache, 404, truncated file), the router re-requests that one script once with a cache-busting query (?v=<buildId>&retry=<ts>) and renders the page if it registers. Only then does it show the diagnostics panel — which now includes the frontend build id, the expected script URL and whether the automatic retry ran (frontend/js/router.js).
Bootstrap now logs which page modules are missing, with their script filenames, before the first render (frontend/js/app-bootstrap.js checkModules).

Build identity is centralised: frontend/version.json buildId === CORPUS_CONFIG.BUILD_ID === <meta name=corpus-build> === the ?v= query on every local CSS/JS in index.html. A test (frontend/tests/build-id.test.mjs) fails if they drift.
The Datasets file-selection change handler is async and fully awaited inside try/catch; a persistence failure shows a warning instead of becoming an unhandled rejection (frontend/js/datasets.js).

Dataset upload: one record per file, bytes go through the backend into the private Supabase bucket, IndexedDB restores the pending queue after Android recreates the page, and a retry reuses the dataset id created before the interruption.
Dataset upload on mobile: the drop zone is a plain container with a transparent full-size overlay input plus a click fallback, so tapping anywhere opens the phone's file manager exactly once.
Fluid scaling for every aspect ratio (phone → 4K/TV) and ?v= cache-busting for local assets.
howToVerify: GET <frontend-url>/version.json — the deployed buildId must equal the buildId committed in frontend/version.json on main.
